## Select the branch that actually applies

| Situation | What you can decide | Result to verify | Where this leads |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Player option | Exercise, decline, or seek clarification before the deadline | Valid notice and exact contract effect | Continued contract or rights review |
| Team option | State your preference and ask about role; club decides exercise | Club's notice and effect | Continued contract or rights review |
| Extension proposal | Counter, decline or proceed on eligible written terms | Existing money separate from additional years; execution | Contract desk |
| Contract expires | Set negotiating priorities | Remaining rights, QO, waiver clearance if relevant, calendar | UFA/RFA market when verified |
| QO received | Review the distinct QO route and its consequences | Actual terms, availability and rights consequences | QO decision or other lawful negotiations |
| Deadline or notice disputed | Request the missing record | Authorized resolution | Keep the consequence unresolved |

A team option uses an informational outcome table in place of this player decision comparison. Never default the player to exercising or declining because a date passed without a verified notice rule.

## What a new contract would require

**New contract ID:** {{only once an actual executed agreement exists}} · **Origin:** {{offer/version or signed sheet}} · **Start / end:** {{dates}} · **Annual schedule:** {{reference}} · **Conditions / registration:** {{status}}.

Expiry does not generate a replacement contract. A player instruction to negotiate is recorded first. Actual club terms, the player's decision, the lawful execution route and final administration precede any new canonical schedule. Preserve the expired contract and all earlier team stints as history.
